source: Local Bash builtin help, read without profiles or startup scripts

builtins.description: . - Execute commands from a file in the current shell.
: - Null command.
[ - Evaluate conditional expression.

builtins.name: alias
builtins.description: alias - Define or display aliases.

builtins.name: bg
builtins.description: bg - Move jobs to the background.

builtins.name: bind
builtins.description: bind - Set Readline key bindings and variables.

builtins.name: break
builtins.description: break - Exit for, while, or until loops.

builtins.name: builtin
builtins.description: builtin - Execute shell builtins.

builtins.name: caller
builtins.description: caller - Return the context of the current subroutine call.

builtins.name: cd
builtins.description: cd - Change the shell working directory.

builtins.name: command
builtins.description: command - Execute a simple command or display information about commands.

builtins.name: compgen
builtins.description: compgen - Display possible completions depending on the options.

builtins.name: complete
builtins.description: complete - Specify how arguments are to be completed by Readline.

builtins.name: compopt
builtins.description: compopt - Modify or display completion options.

builtins.name: continue
builtins.description: continue - Resume for, while, or until loops.

builtins.name: declare
builtins.description: declare - Set variable values and attributes.

builtins.name: dirs
builtins.description: dirs - Display directory stack.

builtins.name: disown
builtins.description: disown - Remove jobs from current shell.

builtins.name: echo
builtins.description: echo - Write arguments to the standard output.

builtins.name: enable
builtins.description: enable - Enable and disable shell builtins.

builtins.name: eval
builtins.description: eval - Execute arguments as a shell command.

builtins.name: exec
builtins.description: exec - Replace the shell with the given command.

builtins.name: exit
builtins.description: exit - Exit the shell.

builtins.name: export
builtins.description: export - Set export attribute for shell variables.

builtins.name: false
builtins.description: false - Return an unsuccessful result.

builtins.name: fc
builtins.description: fc - Display or execute commands from the history list.

builtins.name: fg
builtins.description: fg - Move job to the foreground.

builtins.name: getopts
builtins.description: getopts - Parse option arguments.

builtins.name: hash
builtins.description: hash - Remember or display program locations.

builtins.name: help
builtins.description: help - Display information about builtin commands.

builtins.name: history
builtins.description: history - Display or manipulate the history list.

builtins.name: jobs
builtins.description: jobs - Display status of jobs.

builtins.name: kill
builtins.description: kill - Send a signal to a job.

builtins.name: let
builtins.description: let - Evaluate arithmetic expressions.

builtins.name: local
builtins.description: local - Define local variables.

builtins.name: logout
builtins.description: logout - Exit a login shell.

builtins.name: mapfile
builtins.description: mapfile - Read lines from the standard input into an indexed array variable.

builtins.name: popd
builtins.description: popd - Remove directories from stack.

builtins.name: printf
builtins.description: printf - Formats and prints ARGUMENTS under control of the FORMAT.

builtins.name: pushd
builtins.description: pushd - Add directories to stack.

builtins.name: pwd
builtins.description: pwd - Print the name of the current working directory.

builtins.name: read
builtins.description: read - Read a line from the standard input and split it into fields.

builtins.name: readarray
builtins.description: readarray - Read lines from a file into an array variable.

builtins.name: readonly
builtins.description: readonly - Mark shell variables as unchangeable.

builtins.name: return
builtins.description: return - Return from a shell function.

builtins.name: set
builtins.description: set - Set or unset values of shell options and positional parameters.

builtins.name: shift
builtins.description: shift - Shift positional parameters.

builtins.name: shopt
builtins.description: shopt - Set and unset shell options.

builtins.name: source
builtins.description: source - Execute commands from a file in the current shell.

builtins.name: suspend
builtins.description: suspend - Suspend shell execution.

builtins.name: test
builtins.description: test - Evaluate conditional expression.

builtins.name: times
builtins.description: times - Display process times.

builtins.name: trap
builtins.description: trap - Trap signals and other events.

builtins.name: true
builtins.description: true - Return a successful result.

builtins.name: type
builtins.description: type - Display information about command type.

builtins.name: typeset
builtins.description: typeset - Set variable values and attributes.

builtins.name: ulimit
builtins.description: ulimit - Modify shell resource limits.

builtins.name: umask
builtins.description: umask - Display or set file mode mask.

builtins.name: unalias
builtins.description: unalias - Remove each NAME from the list of defined aliases.

builtins.name: unset
builtins.description: unset - Unset values and attributes of shell variables and functions.

builtins.name: wait
builtins.description: wait - Wait for job completion and return exit status.
